correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly evaluates competing orthogonal projection distances from each support line, locating tie coordinates s=√2−1 and −1−√2. Axis-to-axis two-step return R(t)=(1−|t|)/2 partitions coordinates into three exact intervals I0,I1,I2, and R²(t)=(1+t)/4 contracts I0 to t=1/3, producing the unique four-cycle. All remaining intervals flow to one of five fixed points, with tie endpoints distinguished. Exact interval lengths d,2d,4d and hypotenuse arclength multiplier √2 yield basin arclength 14(2−√2) and perimeter fraction 6−4√2. The recurrence classification implies invariant measures supported on the cycle and five fixed points; only uniform cycle and midpoint atom have positive arclength basins. Independent symbolic arithmetic confirmed length and four-cycle identities; 723 deterministic test trajectories corroborated but were not used as exhaustive continuum proof.
